name: Siro Sbraci
bio: A Florentine gentleman driver who sat at the centre of the Ermini story: a founder of the T.E.S.S. group, and the man who in 1947-48 commissioned the two Gilco-chassis, twin-cam Ermini sports cars that announced the marque at the Firenze-Fiesole in 1948. He won the Coppa Toscana and the Coppa Collina Pistoiese with one of them. Twelfth overall in the 1955 Mille Miglia in a Maserati A6GCS, carrying number 631.
